title_ja: 弊社元社員による金銭の不正受領について
title_en: Notice on improper receipt of money by a former employee
summary_en: Gibraltar discloses that a former employee of its Fukuoka West branch took money from 15 customers, about 58 million yen, in the name of investments (2017-2023 or so), found after a victim came forward in July 2025; a further 31 million yen of improper lending is also noted. The company says no insurance-premium fraud was confirmed.

title_ja: 当社グループ会社によるプレスリリースについて
title_en: Notice on press releases by group companies
summary_en: PGF Life distances itself from the 16 January group releases: it says it is a separate company, sells through financial institutions and agencies under its own controls, and that no money fraud by its own employees has been confirmed. States that contracts and claims-paying ability are unaffected. Updated 23 January.

title_ja: 金融庁 プルデンシャル生命に立ち入り検査へ 行政処分も検討
title_en: FSA to inspect Prudential Life; administrative action also considered
summary_en: NHK reports that the FSA intends to carry out an on-site inspection of Prudential Life soon, over about 3.1bn yen of improper money receipts, and is also weighing administrative action.
note: page read (headline, date and lead in page HTML; body behind NHK consent gate). The inspection is a media report; the FSA's 9 Oct 2026 release later cites its on-site inspection of Prudential Life.

title_en: Prudential of Japan Implements Voluntary 90-Day Suspension of New Sales to Address Previously Disclosed Employee Misconduct
publisher: InsuranceNewsNet (republishing a Prudential Financial release distributed via Business Wire)
summary_en: Prudential Financial and Prudential of Japan announce a voluntary 90-day halt of new sales at Prudential of Japan from 9 Feb 2026, an independent customer reimbursement programme, and recap the January action plan (reimbursement, incentive-pay restructuring, stronger oversight). It confirms that Mabara left on 1 Feb with no advisory role and that Tokumaru, formerly head of PGF Life, succeeds him. In-force servicing is not affected. No financial figures are given.
note: page read in the browser pane (InsuranceNewsNet republication dated 3 Feb 2026 of the Business Wire release; Business Wire original not read).

title_ja: 生保協会会長「甘い部分があった」
title_en: Life Insurance Association chair: 'there were soft spots'
publisher: Kyodo News (via OANDA Japan market news)
summary_en: Kyodo reports the Life Insurance Association chair (Sumitomo Life's president) calling the Prudential Life money misconduct very regrettable and saying the association's 2023 anti-misconduct measures had soft spots in how they were embedded and checked; he also signalled customer warnings.
note: page read (Kyodo text on OANDA Japan). Association statement known only through this press report.

title_ja: 当社出向者による代理店情報持ち出しに係る調査結果について
title_en: Findings on agency information taken out by PGF Life's seconded staff
summary_en: PGF Life reports that 11 seconded staff at 7 partner financial-institution agencies took out 379 items of agency information (sales results and the like) without the host's permission. It found no organisational instruction and ends sales-related secondments at end of March 2026. Executives return part of their pay. This is a separate PGF matter, not the money misconduct.

title_ja: プルデンシャル親会社に立ち入り検査へ　顧客から金銭不正受領で―金融庁
title_en: FSA to inspect Prudential's parent over improper receipts
summary_en: Jiji reports the FSA plans an on-site inspection of the holding company Prudential Holdings of Japan to test whether it knew of and failed to stop the improper receipts; Prudential Life is already under inspection. The minister said the parent's management will be checked.
note: page read (via WebFetch, which returns a model-written digest of the page, not the raw page). Media report of FSA intent; the FSA did not publish an inspection notice that was found.

title_en: Prudential extends Japan sales ban another 6 months at a total $1B loss
summary_en: Reports Prudential Financial extending the Prudential of Japan sales halt by 180 days and estimating a 525-575m dollar hit to 2026 pre-tax adjusted operating income and 400-450m in 2027, with resumption then expected around 6 November.
note: page read in the browser pane (InsuranceNewsNet article by its own reporter, 21 Apr 2026); the underlying earnings material was not read.

title_en: Prudential Life pegs client compensation at ¥4.7 billion
summary_en: Trade press reports that Prudential Life booked about 4.7bn yen of client compensation (5.5bn yen including a related Gibraltar case) as extraordinary losses for FY to March 2026, with profit down sharply and the sales halt running to 5 November.
note: page read (via WebFetch, which returns a model-written digest of the page, not the raw page). Figures are as reported by the outlet; the company's results release (26 May 2026) was not read.

title_en: New Prudential Life victims emerge as Japan's insurance sector faces scrutiny
summary_en: Reports the 24 July compensation update: the independent compensation committee had approved 125 further customers (about 790m yen) from claims beyond the January cases, 101 at Prudential Life (620m) and 24 at Gibraltar (170m). It also notes that the FSA inspection of Prudential Life and its review of parent oversight were continuing.
note: page read (Insurance Business, relaying Asahi). Figures cross-checked against the group's 24 Jul 2026 compensation release (prudential.co.jp/news/pdf/1012/20260724.pdf).

title_ja: プルデンシャル生命に業務停止命令へ　顧客からの金銭詐取問題―金融庁
title_en: FSA to order business suspension for Prudential Life
summary_en: Jiji reports a week before the order that the FSA is leaning toward a partial business suspension for Prudential Life (new contracts and sales, reportedly three months or more) and a business improvement order for the holding company.

title_en: Prudential Financial Provides Update on FSA Orders and Path Forward for its Japan Businesses
publisher: InsuranceNewsNet (republishing a Prudential Financial release distributed via Business Wire)
summary_en: Prudential Financial's release on the FSA orders: Prudential of Japan cannot solicit until 31 Jan 2027; Gibraltar's partial suspension applies only to its Life Consultant channel and not the independent agency channel; Prudential Gibraltar Financial Life is not covered. Both operating units said to be financially sound; impact figures were left to the conference call.
note: page read in the browser pane (InsuranceNewsNet republication dated 20 Oct 2026 of the 9 Oct Business Wire release; Business Wire original not read).

title_ja: 弊社営業社員を通じた営業活動等の一時停止について
title_en: Temporary halt of activities through our sales employees
summary_en: Gibraltar Life tells customers that its Life Plan Consultants will not conduct new solicitation or contract conclusion from 13 Oct 2026 to 31 Jan 2027 and cannot visit or contact customers in that period; business through its contracted agencies continues, and in-force servicing is handled via the head-office contact desk.

publisher: SEC EDGAR (Prudential Financial, Exhibit 99.1 to Form 8-K)
summary_en: Prudential Financial's Q3 2026 earnings release attributes the fall in Japan Businesses pre-tax adjusted operating income to 559m dollars (from 750m) mainly to the Prudential of Japan sales suspension (higher expenses, weaker underwriting) plus lower spread results; Japan sales fell 36% on a constant-dollar basis. The release does not mention Gibraltar or a resumption date.

summary_en: Reports Prudential Financial estimating about 1.3bn dollars of lost pre-tax adjusted operating income across 2026-27, with Gibraltar's partial suspension put at roughly 275m dollars, and says PGF Life is not affected by the suspension.

title_en: Prudential earnings dip as Japan sales suspension offsets U.S. growth
summary_en: Reports that the Prudential of Japan suspension cut Q3 adjusted operating income by about 140m dollars (375m year to date) and is expected to cost about 500m in 2026, with a further 100m from the Japan International Products business. CEO Sullivan expects Prudential of Japan to resume sales in phases from 1 Feb 2027 and Gibraltar to return on the same date.
